corinthians2.6.p1.b1.text: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.

corinthians2.6.p1.b2.text: …Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!

corinthians2.6.p1.b3.text: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.

corinthians2.6.p2.b1.text: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;

corinthians2.6.p2.b2.text: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;

corinthians2.6.p2.b3.text: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

corinthians2.6.p3.b1.text: …dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;

corinthians2.6.p3.b2.text: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich;

corinthians2.6.p4.b1.text: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.

corinthians2.6.p4.b2.text: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.

corinthians2.6.p4.b3.text: As a fair exchange, I ask you as my children: Open wide your hearts also.

corinthians2.6.p5.b1.text: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers.

corinthians2.6.p5.b2.text: …For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them…

corinthians2.6.p5.b3.text: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
